headline: Gonzalo Feasts As test3 Take Charge
deck: Lawro backs test3 past test2 and 123 past test4, both clear favourites.
body: First column here, so no record to own yet. In two decades of guessing scores for the BBC I filed more than 8,000 of these. Some even landed.

ties.line: test3 are the clear favourites. Gibbs-White and Calafiori lead a strong squad, and Gonzalo has one of the leakiest defences to feed off. test2 lean on Havertz, with Rice a doubt at 75 per cent. Isak has a mean lot in front of him.

123 sit top and have Haaland, though his is a hard one this round. B.Fernandes and Schade back him up. test4 have Mbeumo and Raya, but Foden is suspended and does nothing for anyone. I'll go with 123.
